reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the collector and extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the diagnostic genomics model execution batch for use-case-diagnostic-genomics-model-execution: 639 records (488 results, 91 evaluations, 19 configurations, 15 claims including 13 relevance judgements, 13 protocols, 5 datasets, 5 sources, 3 methods). All five source artifacts were re-downloaded and matched their recorded SHA-256; the archived artifacts/*.gz decompress to the same bytes. All 488 results were re-read from the pinned cells with a separate parser (the extractor's scripts were not run) and match in printed value, numeric value, metric, qualifier, unit, direction, locator, configuration and protocol. Derived totals, hours, fold accelerations and cost savings were recomputed. Three results are disputed with source_warnings, the O'Connell judgements were changed to proxy, and descriptive fields were corrected without changing any number; all are listed in docs/reviews/use-cases/diagnostic-genomics-model-execution-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any pipeline.
Figures were not read; memory, accuracy and concordance results shown only in figures are unchecked.
O'Connell Additional file 1 was not retrieved, so the AWS GPU model (V100 or A100) in Table 1 is unresolved.
Europe PMC supplementaryFiles zips are assembled per request, so only the member files and the Samarakoon publisher zip are verified by hash.
Relevance judgements are reviewed but not pinned; the lead records pins with npm run use-cases:repin after the use-case change.
The SHACL step of records add and npm run build were not run; a dry-run addBatch against a scratch copy of the store accepted all 639 records.
